description: Full-text search over titles, abstracts, keywords and authors. Quoted phrases stay exact; OR / AND / NOT and parentheses are supported; common ML acronyms (JSCC, RAG, RLHF, VLA, VLM, DPO, MoE, ...) are expanded. Filter by conference slugs, year range (include year 2027 for ICLR 2027 under-review submissions), acceptance type, topic slug, or author name (must match one author). Defaults to slim rows (id, title, venue, year, decision, rating, url) so clients can scan many papers; pass fields=full or call get_paper/fetch for abstracts. If no paper matches enough of the query, the response is empty or clearly marked as a looser fallback, rather than off-topic any-word hits.

author.description: Author name, e.g. "Kaiming He". Must match tokens of one author name.

decision.description: Acceptance types to keep (case-insensitive exact match). Common values: Oral, Spotlight, Poster, Highlight, Findings, Main; ICLR 2027 also uses Under review, Desk reject, Withdrawn.

fields.description: slim (default for list_papers/search_papers/find_similar_papers) returns id, title, conference, year, decision, rating_avg, url, and short topics. Use full or get_paper/fetch for abstracts. Prefer slim when scanning or exporting a conference.

limit.description: Results per page. slim: search up to 200 (default 10), list_papers up to 250 (default 100). full: 1-25 (default 10).

query.description: Search words. Quoted phrases stay exact; OR / AND / NOT and parentheses work. Common acronyms (JSCC, RAG, RLHF, VLA, VLM, DPO, MoE, ...) are expanded.

topic.description: Topic slug from list_conferences topics_for (use iclr2027-* for ICLR 2027 primary areas)

year_from.description: Include ICLR 2027 under-review submissions only when the year range overlaps 2027.

name: search_papers

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor to get the next page; null when there are no more results.

id.description: Readable id, e.g. iclr2026-1058 or iclr2027-n42. Pass to get_paper or fetch for the full record.

decision.description: Acceptance type, e.g. Oral, Spotlight, Poster

id.description: Readable id, e.g. iclr2025-12345. Pass to get_paper or find_similar_papers.

title: Search papers
